correctness.rationale: Derive all original sum intervals and exact even gap slices, giving finite disjoint blocks and exact endpoints. Prove the quotient generating set by pairing odd original generators. Evaluate PF condition on a generating set: small-generator translates can meet only the next gap block; explicit endpoint differences leave at most two parity-selected candidates; adding a or a+k rejects all earlier blocks, and the penultimate exception is checked. The argument covers T=0 and the entire parameter domain. Independent Apéry checks pass on 5,476 cases, and direct original-generator DP on eight cases; tests are secondary to the proof.
